description: This source file defines character utility functions, including a mapping for case conversion and character normalization, with extensive comments on how to update the character maps using Unicode data and ICU libraries.

classes.name: LatinCapitalSmallPair
classes.description: A struct representing a pair of Unicode code points for uppercase and lowercase Latin characters used in case conversion mapping.

methods.name: CharUtils::latin_tolower
methods.description: Converts a given Unicode code point to its lowercase equivalent using a binary search on the sorted character map.
